sections.text: We have reduced prices on our home appliance line by 10% to clear excess inventory. At the same time, we are seeing increased demand for our budget-friendly electronics as consumers become more price-sensitive. RetailMax sells consumer electronics through our network of 500 stores and e-commerce platform.
